gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford ___ another month abroad.
She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: Could you help me ___ these boxes upstairs?
gaps.explanation: help takes a bare infinitive or to-infinitive: help me (to) carry. Both accepted.
too + adjective + to-infinitive: too young to stay.

gaps.sentence: The scheme aims ___ younger visitors to the museum.
gaps.explanation: aim + to-infinitive: aims to attract (aim at + -ing is also possible in BrE).
seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.
fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.
